<body>
    <div class="instructions">
        <h2>How this works</h2>
        <p>Each letter below is a link. Clicking one appends that character to the word you're building and reloads this page with the updated word.</p>
        <p>The route is <code>/textinput/{currentLetter}/{wholeInput}/{id}</code> — <code>currentLetter</code> is the character you clicked, <code>wholeInput</code> is everything typed so far, and <code>id</code> keeps the URL's unique.</p>                                 
    </div>

    <div class="current-word">{{(string.IsNullOrEmpty(newWholeInput) ? "&nbsp;" : newWholeInput)}}</div>

    {{links}}
</body><body>
